newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan non-life insurers rise as laggards bought.
newsitem.headline: Japan non-life insurers rise as laggards bought.

text.p: Shares in Japanese non-life insurers rose in Monday afternoon trading, bucking the overall market trend, as investors sought laggard stocks.

As of 0441 GMT, Tokio Marine & Fire Insurance Co Ltd was up 40 yen at 1,420 with trade totalling 2.67 million shares, making it the second most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
Sumitomo Marine & Fire Insurance Co Ltd stood at 890, up eight yen after briefly climbing to 897, a new high for the 1997 calendar year.
The sector was at the top of the list of gaining sectors.
"Attention drifts to issues fuelled by domestic demand when currencies are unstable," one broker said.
